method: Native frames decoded by the parent frame-review session (exact-PTS ffmpeg select with showinfo proof, BelowNormal, 4 threads, streamed, obs64/Marvel absent and free RAM >= 2 GiB before every window): all 74 owner review frames (hash-equal, own_hud equal), every 30th frame across the 5 accepts, every 6th frame through 2 s at each accepted edge plus the frames just outside, every 12th frame for 1 s after each accepted end, +/-24 frames around f14982, f22407, f31848 and f40928, and every 3rd frame around the two '4' presses. Visual inspection on contact sheets (1 s bulk, 0.1 s edges with after-frames, check windows, '4' windows, all owner frames of rejects). Media re-hashed by plain read (equals the registry pin). Inputs replayed by the parent: bound mouse 1/2/4 only; no button 3, T, UI key, scroll wheel or focus change; the only unbound key is VK52 '4'.
findings: VK52 '4' is the quick-chat 'Thank you!' voice line: each press posts a 'Thank you!' line to the team chat log with no menu, wheel or camera change. Suggest recording it as a communication binding (it also appears inside accepts in -5, -7 and -8).
Every accepted end falls before the following death, ping/emote wheel or end-of-match transition by at least one native frame (seg-014 by ~0.05 s, seg-021 by ~0.05 s).
Own-HUD reader misses inside accepts are own play under combat effects, bonus health, heal or damage vignettes and enemy area tints; no spectate, kill cam or replay frame found inside any accept.
